ceu: ✦ The square between Venus and Mars

s.k: Look at what you have, not at what you lack.
t: Today's emotions run through your wallet and through what you consider yours. Protect what you have built, without closing yourself off.
The square between Venus and Mars creates some tension between your horizons and routine. Hear both sides before you decide.
With Mars retrograde in your daily routine sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Ask for what you are owed, politely and without fear.

s.k: A day to put yourself first.
t: The Moon passes through your sign today and leaves your emotions close to the surface: it is a day to listen to yourself first and decide later.
The square between Venus and Mars creates some tension between intimacy and romance. Protect your peace and choose the battles worth fighting.
With Mars retrograde in your romance sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Before saying yes to someone, ask yourself whether it is also a yes for you.

s.k: A day to recharge on the inside.
t: Today sensitivity is high and tiredness may appear. Sleep well and protect yourself from noise.
The square between Venus and Mars creates some tension between relationships and family. A short pause avoids a long argument.
With Mars retrograde in your home and family sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Say a short prayer or meditation for your peace.

s.k: Share a dream with someone who believes in it.
t: With the Moon in your house of dreams, the future feels closer. Write down a wish and a first step.
The square between Venus and Mars creates some tension between routine and conversations. Today's challenge is teaching you patience.
With Mars retrograde in your communication sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Invite someone for a coffee or a walk.

s.k: Your goals ask for a firm step.
t: The Moon asks you for responsibility and vision. Think about what you want to build over the coming months.
The square between Venus and Mars creates some tension between romance and money. Do not take to heart what has nothing to do with you.
With Mars retrograde in your money sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Keep a promise you made to yourself today.

s.k: A day to learn and broaden your horizons.
t: A day to step out of your mental routine. Try a different path, even a small one.
The square between Venus and Mars creates some tension between family and your image. Put off big decisions until the dust settles.
With Mars retrograde in your self-image sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Sign up for, or find out about, a course that interests you.

s.k: Trust is the word of the day.
t: The Moon passes through your deepest area. Emotions arrive with intensity, and with them the wish for truth.
The square between Venus and Mars creates some tension between conversations and your inner life. Do one thing at a time and the day will calm down.
With Mars retrograde in your inner life sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Trust a secret only to someone who has already proved worthy of it.

s.k: Today the other person is your mirror.
t: Today relationships need attention: a partner, an associate or a close friend needs to feel your presence.
The square between Venus and Mars creates some tension between money and friendships. You do not have to choose right now: look for the middle ground.
With Mars retrograde in your friendship sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Do not try to change the other person: try to understand them.

s.k: Organise the day and the day will organise you.
t: With the Moon in your house of daily work, practical tasks go well. Start with the one you keep putting off.
The square between Venus and Mars creates some tension between your image and your career. Be firm, but without hardening your heart.
With Mars retrograde in your career sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Start the day with the hardest task and the rest will feel light.

s.k: Your heart wants a celebration and a little light.
t: The Moon lights up love, children and the inner child we all have. Laugh more and worry less.
The square between Venus and Mars creates some tension between your inner life and your horizons. Breathe before reacting, because haste is the worst adviser today.
With Mars retrograde in your horizons sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Laugh at yourself when something goes less well.

s.k: The heart of the day is at home.
t: The Moon asks you for a safe harbour. If the day is hectic outside, create calm in your own space.
The square between Venus and Mars creates some tension between friendships and intimacy. If something goes wrong, it is just an adjustment and not the end.
With Mars retrograde in your intimacy sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Make peace with a childhood memory.

s.k: One conversation can change the course of the day.
t: The Moon passes through your area of conversations: messages, calls and quick meetings set the pace of the day.
The square between Venus and Mars creates some tension between your career and relationships. Tension is a sign of growth, not of failure.
With Mars retrograde in your relationships sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Apologise for a careless word, if need be.
